a.lede: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.
a.title: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents.

b.lede: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.
b.title: All the AI agents that can live in your text messages
